{{Quote|I'll stay awake all night and escape as soon as I hear the first dawndaddy.|Teebo|<ref name="AoT" />}}
The '''dawndaddy''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] that lived on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] and made a noise at the rise of the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] [[Star/Legends|sun]], [[Ibleam]],<ref name="AoT" /> signaling dawn.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|174|dawndaddy}}</ref> At one point, when the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] was held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] by an individual known as the [[Grudakk]], he decided to stay [[Sleep/Legends|awake]] for the whole night and escape once he heard the first dawndaddy. However, Teebo's plan was unable to come to fruition, as the exhausted Ewok fell asleep quickly.<ref name="AoT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The dawndaddy was first mentioned in the [[1984]] young-readers book ''[[The Adventures of Teebo: A Tale of Magic and Suspense]]'', written by [[Joe Johnston]].<ref name="AoT" />
